name: Liskarm
description: Blocks 3 enemies and attacks from long range.

candidates.name: Tactical Defense
candidates.description: Restores 1 Skill Point to this Operator and a random ally in the surrounding tiles when attacked

levels.description:
Attack Interval <@ba.vdown>increases</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, attacks deal <@ba.vup>Arts damage</> to at most <@ba.vup>{attack@max_target}</> enemies and have <@ba.vup>{attack@buff_prob:0%}</> chance to <$ba.stun>Stun</> the hit targets for <@ba.vup>{attack@stun}</> seconds
<@ba.rem>Liskarm is <$ba.stun>Stunned</> for {stun} seconds after the skill duration</>
